description:
Adopters need the toolchain, platform, hardware and feature combinations gf2 supports, and the current limitations, stated once.

## Background

Permanent pages target researchers evaluating or adopting gf2 and assume technical competence. Explanatory prose is freshly authored; only independently verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and empirical data are reused from prior material. Pages state current supported behavior only.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A page under `docs/reference/` states the supported toolchain, operating systems, CPU and GPU requirements, per-crate Cargo features, available installation mechanisms, the crate excluded from the default workspace, and current limitations, verified against current code, manifests and tests.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its prose and structure are freshly authored; reused items from crate manifests, CI configuration and the root README are limited to verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and data.
- [hard] REQ-03: It contains no elementary primer, historical narration, migration language, speculation, future promise, marketing language or performance figure.
- [hard] REQ-04: The page is listed in `docs/index.md`, and its links, anchors and citations resolve.
title: Write the supported configurations reference page
